description: Brimbank Traffic Signal Locations is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Brimbank City Council. This table outlines all Brimbank City Council’s traffic signals. It shows the traffic signal’s location as well as its type. While all due care has been taken to ensure the dataset is accurate and current, there may be errors or omissions in it. Coverage: Brimbank City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Brimbank City Council. Its tags are Airport traffic, signal-box. It offers 4 resource(s) in ESRI SHAPEFILE - ZIPPED, GEOJSON, WFS, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-2.5-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
